## Working session summary

Implemented and finalized [PR #41: fix: publish relative-path support to npm](https://github.com/link-foundation/gh-upload-log/pull/41). It is ready for review, mergeable, and all checks pass on commit `b8342cf`.

Root cause: the relative-path fix already existed, but failed npm releases left users on `0.8.2`. The release scripts treated nonzero command results as success. The fix now:

- Validates npm setup and publish exit codes.
- Uses Node 24 and npm `^11.5.1`, matching [npm trusted-publishing requirements](https://docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers/).
- Retries failed publishes without creating false-success releases.
- Reports the real package version from `package.json`.
- Adds regression tests and a patch changeset.

Verification:

- 106 local tests passed.
- Lint, formatting, and file-size checks passed.
- Bare and `./` paths verified with a 40.29 MB log.
- CI passed on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
